functions.purpose: XML/attr config loader for a 'LemonSkill' record. Reads sub-record at param_1+0x9c (0x24-byte stride records), then reads the wide-string attribute 'LemonSkill', tokenizes it on ';' and atoi()s each token into an int vector (the skill-id list).
formulas: Delimiter = 0x3b = ';' (passed to tokenizer FUN_100e4b30).
Per token: local_470 = atoi(token); token records stride 0x18 (24) bytes (iVar8 += 0x18).

Sub-record vector at param_1+0x9c grows by 0x24 (36) bytes per element; when *(param_1+0x9c)==*(param_1+0xa0) a new element is emplaced (FUN_11690f00) else FUN_1167a440 fills in place and advances +0x24.
int vector push: *(iVar5-8) == *(iVar5-4) -> grow (FUN_10463c40) else *piVar1=val; *(iVar5-8)+=4.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only config loader, but defines the authoritative schema: 'LemonSkill' is a ';'-separated list of skill IDs stored as an int vector.
functions.notes: vtbl calls on param_2: +0x10=HasAttr, +0x24=GetString. FUN_100f67b0 registers the attr name; DAT flag bits are one-time init guards. FUN_11a89daa=stack-cookie check.

functions.purpose: Config loader for a monster body-part record (part-break / stagger / elemental-buildup definition). Reads PartID (looks up/creates part record iVar2 via FUN_11680c60), PartName, then per-element resistance/accumulation values, Scar, and a 5-row table of per-attack-type loot/damage columns.
formulas: iVar2+0x14 = Unbalance (float, KO/stagger buildup), iVar2+0x18 = UnbalanceMulti (float, default DAT_11de9978)
iVar2+0x1c = Fall (float, topple/mount buildup), iVar2+0x20 = FallMulti (float)
iVar2+0x24 = WaterAcc (uint), iVar2+0x28 = WaterAccMulti (float)
iVar2+0x2c = FireAcc (uint), iVar2+0x30 = FireAccMulti (float)
iVar2+0x34 = ElectricAcc (uint), iVar2+0x38 = ElectricAccMulti (float)
iVar2+0x3c = DragonAcc (uint), iVar2+0x40 = DragonAccMulti (float)
iVar2+0x44 = IceAcc (uint), iVar2+0x48 = IceAccMulti (float)
iVar2+0x4c = Scar (float, wound buildup)

Column loop: 5 iterations (index 0..4, iVar3 step 0x10 until <0x50). Per row it reads string arrays LootSkillLv%d, DmgVal%d, Cut%d, Hammer%d, Shoot%d, Fire%d, Water%d, Electric%d, Dragon%d, Ice%d, ProcessLv%d (each %d = 1..5).

Row records: one at iVar2+0x58 stride 0xd*4=0x34 (52 bytes) carrying {back-ptr=iVar2, index}; one at iVar2+0x198 stride 4 (float LootSkillLv). Bitmasks built: field local_558 bit0=Cut present, bit1=Hammer; field uVar9 bits0..4 = Shoot/Fire/Water/Electric/Dragon (per-column present flags).
iVar2+4 set to 1 (record-loaded flag) at end.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative-relevant: defines monster part-break thresholds (Unbalance/Fall/Scar), elemental status accumulation caps per part, and multipliers the server needs to compute KO/topple/wound and elemental buildup.
functions.notes: DAT_11de9978 = default multiplier constant (uninitialized in dump; likely 1.0f). Also formats 'Parts.%s.' and recurses FUN_1188e230. vtbl +0x20=GetInt, +0x2c=GetUInt(byref), +0x30=GetFloat, +0x34=GetDouble(byref).

functions.purpose: Refreshes an entity's active buff/abnormal-state display+selection. Iterates the buff-entry vector (param_1+0x42c..0x430), calls per-buff update (FUN_1186e760, FUN_116ab0a0), selects the highest-priority abnormal state, extracts two special buff values, and does {token} text substitution for status HUD strings.
formulas: Buff-entry vector: base=*(param_1+0x42c), end=*(param_1+0x430), stride 4; each entry object has buff-info sub at *entry+0x118 and secondary at *entry+0x168; entries collected when either is nonzero (cap 100).
Priority selection scans for entry with *(buff+0xf4)==1, then ==2, then ==3 (abnormal-status priority order 1>2>3).
If a buff has *(buff+0x50)==0x3ed (1005): param_1+0x420 = *(buff+0x144).
If a buff has *(buff+0x50)==0x3ef (1007): param_1+0x428 = *(buff+0x144).
Text substitution tokens '{'=0x7b, '}'=0x7d; 4 replacement key/value pairs (local_84/local_5c/local_34/local_c) via FUN_116a71d0/FUN_10897f50.
functions.serverRelevance: mixed: abnormal-status priority ordering (fields at buff+0xf4 values 1/2/3) and buff-type ids (buff+0x50) are gameplay-authoritative concepts; the {token} string build is client HUD. Value read from buff+0x144.
functions.notes: Buff struct offsets: +0x50=type/id, +0xf4=priority class, +0x144=magnitude/value, +0x118 & +0x168=sub-info ptrs. Buff-id constants 0x3ed(1005) and 0x3ef(1007).

functions.purpose: Constructor for the 'PlayerLockHPBuff' buff-effect object. Installs vtable PTR_FUN_11d3f5b4 and sets the effect name string 'PlayerLockHPBuff'. Object size 0x24.

functions.purpose: Looks up a static skill definition by skill id via the CSkillInfo manager, bounds-checks the group array, and on success returns the resolved row (FUN_116cd100).
formulas: groupIndex = skillId/100000 - *(mgr+0x24) (base group id).
Valid if groupIndex in [0, (*(mgr+0x18)-*(mgr+0x14))>>2) and *(mgr+0x14 array[groupIndex]) != 0.
So skill IDs encode group = skillId/100000.
functions.serverRelevance: validation/lookup: server must use the same skill-id encoding (skillId / 100000 = skill group) to resolve skill definitions.
functions.notes: CSkillInfo manager via CSkillInfo__GetInfoManager. mgr+0x14=array base, +0x18=array end, +0x24=base group id.

functions.purpose: Thin wrapper: ensures the CSkillInfo manager singleton is initialized then calls FUN_116cd1b0(param_1).
Gets the CSkillInfo manager and tail-calls its vtable slot +0x28 (count/clear/iterate accessor).

Core static skill-definition config parser. Reads skill id, level, the four special-attack status buildup values, town/angry flags, then branches on skill-type code to read fire-mode/anim/group/attack fields, and finally common event/name fields. Registers itself into a vector at param_1+0x137.
formulas: param_1[5] = skillid; param_1[6] = level (forced to 1 if 0).
skillType = vtbl+0x3c() (local_464/piVar1); switch cases 1,2,3,9 vs 4-8 vs 5,6,7 select different field sets.

SkillSpecialAttack_Paraylze -> param_1[9] (read as double, stored (int)(float)); SkillSpecialAttack_Poison -> param_1[7]; SkillSpecialAttack_Sleep -> param_1[8]; SkillSpecialAttack_Dynamite -> param_1[10].
IsTown -> *(bool*)(param_1+0xb) = (val==1); IsAngry -> *(bool*)((int)param_1+0x2d) = (val==1).
group1..group4 -> param_1[0x2c],[0x2d],[0x2e],[0x2f].
type in {1,2,9}: FireModeName -> param_1+0x30. type in {5,6,7}: AnimSeq -> param_1+0x36. type in {1,3,9} also FireModeName -> param_1+0xe.
type in {1,4,5,6,7,9}: SkillAttack -> param_1[0x3c], SkillAttrAttack -> param_1[0x3d], SkillSpecialAttack -> param_1[0x3e] (all double default DAT_11de9978), AttackInfo string -> param_1+0x3f.
type in {1,9}: three ids -> param_1[0x45],[0x46],[0x49]; type 2: CBEvent string -> param_1+0x4b.
Common: FUN_1186f860 parsed lists -> param_1[0x58], param_1[0xa4], param_1[0xf0]; string fields param_1+0x59, +99(0x63), +0x9d(eventname), +0xa5, +0xaf, +0xf1, +0xfb.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative: this is the master skill definition. Special-attack status buildup magnitudes (Paralyze/Poison/Sleep/Dynamite), skill level, damage multipliers (SkillAttack/SkillAttrAttack/SkillSpecialAttack), and skill-type classification are server-authoritative for effect application.
functions.notes: param_1[N] = param_1+N*4. FUN_116d0aa0 / FUN_116d0d60 parse type-specific subsections. DAT_11de9978 = default value for the Attack floats (likely 1.0f).

functions.purpose: Config loader for an item-grant entry that can also apply a buff. Reads ItemID, ItemAmountMin/Max, DeleteWhenFull flag, BuffID, and BindType.
formulas: param_1[0] = ItemID; param_1[1] = ItemAmountMin; param_1[2] = ItemAmountMax.
*(bool*)(param_1+3) = (DeleteWhenFull != 0).
param_1[4] = BuffID.
BindType (uint): only stored to param_1[5] if value < 5 (valid range 0..4).
costs: ItemAmountMin / ItemAmountMax = quantity range of item granted.

functions.purpose: Config loader for a gatherable-resource type. Reads ResourceType index (bound <20), ResourceName, DefaultSkillID, MainType, MidType, SubType, IgnoreTool flag, CollectPriority; writes into an indexed record array (first-write-wins).
formulas: ResourceType (uVar3) must be < 0x14 (20) or record is skipped.
Record base = param_1 + ResourceType*0x1c (28-byte stride).

Written only if *(base+0x48)==0 (empty slot): base+0x48=DefaultSkillID, base+0x3c=MainType, base+0x40=MidType, base+0x44=SubType, base+0x4c=CollectPriority (default = ResourceType+1), base+0x50=(bool)IgnoreTool.

functions.notes: CollectPriority defaults to ResourceType+1 when attr absent.

functions.purpose: 2D-sparse-map lookup into the CPetSkillSlotUnlockInfo table (pet skill-slot unlock requirements) by key.
formulas: key valid if key!=-1 and (key!=0 or mgr+0x30==0) and mgr+0x28!=0.
k = key - *(mgr+0x30); valid if 0<=k<*(mgr+0x24).
row = array[k / *(mgr+0x28)]; if row!=0 return row[k % *(mgr+0x28)].
mgr+0x28 = row stride, +0x30 = base key, +0x24 = capacity, +0x20 = row-array base.

functions.serverRelevance: authoritative: monster spawn parameters incl. a BuffID applied to the spawned monsters; server manages spawns.

functions.purpose: Linear-index lookup into the CEquipRandPassiveSkillActivateSetInfo table (equip random-passive-skill activation sets).
formulas: valid if 0<=index<((mgr+0x18 - mgr+0x14)>>2); return array[index].

functions.purpose: Linear-index lookup into the CEquipSuitSkillInfo table (armor/equipment set-bonus skills).
formulas: valid if 0<=index<((mgr+0x18 - mgr+0x14)>>2); return array[index].

functions.purpose: Config loader for an equipment 'Excellent' (appraisal) rank record. Reads Rank, Excellent_Point, Excellent_Judegement_Rank, Excellent_Rank_Name, then up to 10 Buff_N strings each parsed 'buffId;degree' and pushed into a buff vector.
formulas: param_1+0x10 = Rank; +0x18 = Excellent_Point; +0x1c = Excellent_Judegement_Rank; +0x20 = Excellent_Rank_Name (string).

Buff_1..Buff_10: each read as string then sscanf_s(str, "%d;%d", &buffId, &degree). If parsed==2 and (buffId!=0 || degree!=0): push {buffId, degree} (8-byte pair) into vector at param_1+0x3c (advance +8). Grow via FUN_119e5100.
Format string '%d;%d' = buffId;degree.
costs: Excellent_Point = appraisal points threshold; degree = per-buff magnitude.
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative: equipment appraisal rank -> up to 10 (buff, degree) grants; server applies these buffs.

functions.purpose: If the context flag FUN_11679c30() is set, unregisters a skill mapping (FUN_1169e9d0 with *(param_1+0x14)) and touches the CPetMonsterSkillInfo manager. Cleanup/teardown of a pet-monster skill record.
formulas: Uses skill id at param_1+0x14.
functions.serverRelevance: plumbing/cleanup; the skill-id unregistration mirrors the registration in the display parser.

functions.purpose: Config loader mapping a Hunter-Rank (HR) level to buffs. Reads HRLevel -> +0x10, two uint fields -> +0x14/+0x18, and a 'Buffs' string parsed into a buff container at +0x1c (FUN_1162bea0).
formulas: param_1+0x10 = HRLevel; +0x14 = uint field (DAT_11d6d28c key, default 0); +0x18 = uint field (DAT_11d522e8 key, default 0); +0x1c = parsed Buffs list (FUN_1162bea0).
functions.serverRelevance: authoritative: HR-level -> buff-set mapping (rank/world buffs); server applies rank buffs.
functions.notes: +0x14/+0x18 keys not resolved to names in dump (DAT_11d6d28c, DAT_11d522e8).
